name: KOKOROBAKO
source:
Being an idol is hard work. Sometimes, you get the short end of the stick, and you're stuck in an interview in the middle of June with no sleep the night before.

Sometimes, you run into your ex, who's the farthest thing from an idol someone could be.

...And sometimes, you wish you could abandon everything you worked towards to be with her instead.

[From [url=https://gnocchibabu.itch.io/kokorobako]itch.io[/url]]
